home.hero.title: AI-Powered Scheme Matching for Your Future
home.hero.subtitle: Tell us about your project, education or financial needs. Scheme Up intelligently identifies suitable schemes, estimates your financing and helps you find the right Channel Partner.
home.how.title: How It Works
home.how.step1.title: Tell Us About You
home.how.step1.desc: Share basic details about your income, purpose and location.
home.how.step2.title: AI Matches Your Scheme
home.how.step2.desc: Our engine checks eligibility rules and explains its recommendation.
home.how.step3.title: Calculate Your Financing
home.how.step3.desc: See estimated loan, EMI, interest and your contribution.
home.how.step4.title: Find the Right Channel Partner
home.how.step4.desc: Locate an authorized partner who can process your application.
home.why.title: Why Scheme Up?
home.why.card1.title: AI-Powered Recommendations
home.why.card1.desc: Hybrid rule-based and ML matching tuned for government scheme guidelines.
home.why.card2.title: Explainable Decisions
home.why.card2.desc: Every recommendation shows exactly why a scheme fits your profile.
home.why.card3.title: Multilingual Support
home.why.card3.desc: Available in 8 Indian languages to serve every region.
home.why.card4.title: EMI Calculator
home.why.card4.desc: Estimate monthly repayment, interest and total cost instantly.
home.why.card5.title: Partner Locator
home.why.card5.desc: Find and rank nearby SCAs, banks, RRBs and NBFC-MFIs.
home.why.card6.title: Eligibility Guidance
home.why.card6.desc: Understand income, loan and project criteria before you apply.
home.why.card7.title: Transparent Information
home.why.card7.desc: Scheme data comes from the backend and is clearly labeled.
home.categories.title: Scheme Categories
home.categories.micro.title: Micro Finance
home.categories.micro.desc: For smaller income-generating projects up to approximately ₹1.40 lakh.
home.categories.term.title: Term Loan
home.categories.term.desc: For larger business and project financing up to approximately ₹50 lakh.
home.categories.edu.title: Educational Loan
home.categories.edu.desc: For eligible higher-education expenses at recognized institutions.
home.impact.title: Trusted Guidance at Scale
home.demo.banner: This is a demo platform with sample data for demonstration purposes. It is not affiliated with any government body.
